subject: general
question: What is the name of the pilot initiative launched by the Government of India in Sonbhadra, Uttar Pradesh on 24 June 2025, which is focused on vocational training for adolescent girls?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NAVYA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NAVYA** is a unique **pilot initiative** launched by the **Government of India** on **24 June 2025**.
 
• The program was specifically inaugurated in **Sonbhadra district** of **Uttar Pradesh**, which is identified as one of the **Aspirational Districts** under the central government's development framework.
 
• The primary focus of the **NAVYA** scheme is to provide **vocational training** and **skill development** to **adolescent girls**, particularly those belonging to **marginalized** and **tribal communities**.
 
• The initiative aims to bridge the **gender gap** in technical education by offering courses in **digital literacy**, **financial management**, and **healthcare assistance**. ***Hence, the correct answer is NAVYA.***
 
• It is designed to empower girls between the **age group of 14 to 18 years** who may have dropped out of formal schooling or require additional job-oriented skills to improve their **employability**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographic Significance of Sonbhadra:**
 
 
• **Sonbhadra** is the only district in **India** that shares its boundary with four states: **Madhya Pradesh**, **Chhattisgarh**, **Jharkhand**, and **Bihar**.
 
• Choosing this location for the **NAVYA** pilot ensures that the benefits reach a high concentration of **Scheduled Tribes (ST)** and **Scheduled Castes (SC)** populations.
 
 
 
• **The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP):**
 
 
• Launched by the **NITI Aayog** in **January 2018**, the program aims to quickly and effectively transform **112** of the most under-developed districts across the country.
 
• Initiatives like **NAVYA** are part of the broader strategy to improve indicators in **Health & Nutrition**, **Education**, and **Skill Development** within these regions.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with other options:**
 
 
• **DHARANI:** This is generally associated with the **Integrated Land Records Management System** in **Telangana**, aimed at digitizing land data.
 
• **MITRA:** Usually refers to the **PM-MITRA (Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel)** scheme, which focuses on the **textile industry** and infrastructure.
 
• **AMRUTA:** While similar to **AMRUT** (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation), it does not specifically target adolescent vocational training in the context of the **June 2025** Sonbhadra launch.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Skill India Mission Convergence:** The **NAVYA** initiative works in tandem with the **Skill India Mission** (launched in **2015**) to ensure that the curriculum meets the current **industry standards**.
 
• **Socio-Economic Impact:** By targeting **adolescent girls**, the government aims to prevent **early marriages** and promote **economic independence** among women in rural **India**.
 
• **Digital Integration:** A key feature of **NAVYA** is the **"Digital Sakhi"** component, where trained girls act as catalysts for **digital payments** and online services in their respective villages.
 
• **Monitoring and Evaluation:** The success of this **pilot project** in **Uttar Pradesh** will determine its nationwide rollout across other **tribal-dominated districts** in **2026**.
